requirements.text: The DUAP System shall collect probe vehicle data.
The DUAP data elements shall include probe vehicle data fields corresponding to the SAE J2735 format as enumerated in APPENDIX C - SAE J2735 Probe Data Elements.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from the VII Proof of Concept (POC) Probe Data Service (PDS) using the X-031 interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from the Chrysler Fast Feedback (telematics demonstration) fleet using the Chrysler telematics interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from Southeast Michigan Snow and Ice Management (SEMSIM) using the SEMSIM interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from Suburban Mobility Authority for Regional Transportation (SMART) Transit using the SMART Transit interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from The Rapid Transit using the “The Rapid Transit” interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from Ann Arbor Transit using the Ann Arbor Transit interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from Detroit Department of Transportation (DDOT) Transit using the DDOT interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from the MDOT fleet using the MDOT probe vehicle data interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from truck fleets using the truck fleets’ interfaces.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect probe vehicle data from the car rental fleets using the car rental fleets’ interfaces.
The DUAP System shall be able to collect weather data.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect weather data from the Road Commission for Oakland County (RCOC) Road Weather Information Systems (RWIS) using the RCOC RWIS interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect weather data from the MDOT RWIS using the MDOT RWIS interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect weather data from Michigan Department of Natural Resources (MDNR) weather information systems using the MDNR interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect weather data from MDOT Aeronautics Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS) using the AWOS interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect Clarus weather data as enumerated in APPENDIX D -Weather Data Elements from Clarus.

The DUAP Input Services shall be able to include weather condition fields corresponding to the SAE J2354 WeatherInformation structure as enumerated in APPENDIX E -SAE J2354 Weather Information Elements.
The DUAP System shall be able to collect Origin/Destination (O/D) data.
The DUAP System shall collect roadway traffic data.
The DUAP data elements shall include roadway event information data fields corresponding to the SAE J2354 structure as enumerated in APPENDIX F - SAE J2354 EventInformation Elements.
The DUAP Input Services shall include roadway traffic data fields corresponding to the SAE J2354 structure as enumerated in APPENDIX G - SAE J2354 LinkTrafficInformation Elements.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from the MITS Center using the MITS traffic data interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from the Western Michigan Traffic Management System (WMTMS) using the WMTMS interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from the RCOC system using the RCOC system interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from the Road Commission of Macomb County (RCMC) system using the RCMC system interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from NAVTEQ Corporation’s Traffic.com using the Traffic.com interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect roadway traffic data from the Traffic Monitoring System for Highways (TMS/H) using the TMS/H interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect traffic data from the Ann Arbor Traffic Management Center (TMC) system using the Ann Arbor TMC interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect traffic data from the Detroit TMC system using the Detroit TMC interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect traffic data from the Superior and Traverse City North Regions TMC system using the Superior and Traverse City North Regions TMC interface.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect traffic data from the Statewide TMC system using the Statewide TMC interface.
The DUAP System shall be able to collect traveler information.
The DUAP System shall be able to collect road condition data.
The DUAP Input Services shall be able to collect road condition data from Traffic Management Systems (TMS) using the TMS interface.
The DUAP System shall be able to collect work zone (lane closure) data.
The DUAP System shall log Input Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall be able to organize the sequence of execution of computational modules.
The DUAP System shall allow the system administrator to add, modify, and delete Input Services.
The DUAP System shall allow the system administrator to add, modify, and delete Computational Services.
The DUAP System shall allow the system administrator to add, modify, and delete Output Services.
The DUAP System shall allow the system administrator to add, modify, and delete Presentation Services.
The DUAP System shall restrict access to authorized users.
The DUAP System shall keep records of user access.
The DUAP System shall allow a system administrator to add, modify and delete user access rights.
The DUAP System shall be able to log system operations.
The DUAP System shall log Administrative Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall cache (both raw and derived) probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall cache (both raw and derived) traffic data.
The DUAP System shall cache (both raw and derived) road weather data.
The DUAP System shall cache (both raw and derived) road condition data.
The DUAP System shall cache data only if the data record associates the data with its source, a geo-referenced location, and a timestamp.
The DUAP System shall cache data for 1 week.
The DUAP System shall allow data to be accessed as soon as it is cached.
The DUAP System shall log Dynamic Data Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall derive traffic data from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive speed from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive congestion level based on volume to capacity from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive traffic counts from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive traffic distribution (occupancy) from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive freeway queue length from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive arterial queue length from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive travel time from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive turning movements from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall be able to infer incidents from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to infer incident occurrences from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to infer incident locations from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to infer incident type from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to infer incident severity from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall be able to derive road surface weather observations from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall be able to derive travel demand from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall be able to derive roadway surface conditions from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive pavement surface conditions from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive bridge surface conditions from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive pothole location from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Computational Services shall be able to derive pothole severity from probe vehicle data.
The DUAP System shall be able to identify high risk locations.
The DUAP System shall be able to calculate measures of effectiveness.
The DUAP System shall be able to perform data quality checking.
The DUAP System shall log Computational Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall store geo-references for Michigan roadways.
The DUAP System shall store DUAP system configuration data.
The DUAP System shall archive cached data.
The DUAP Persistent Data Services shall be able to archive cached (raw and derived) probe vehicle data.
The DUAP Persistent Data Services shall be able to archive cached (raw and derived) traffic data.
The DUAP Persistent Data Services shall be able to archive cached (raw and derived) roadway weather data.
The DUAP Persistent Data Services shall be able to archive cached (raw and derived) road condition data.
The DUAP System shall log Persistent Data Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall publish data.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traveler data in SAE J2354 format as enumerated in Appendix E.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish roadway traffic information in Traffic Management Data Dictionary (TMDD) format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic data to TMS using the TMS interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish data to SEMSIM using the SEMSIM interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic data in the VISSIM traffic analysis tool VISSIM interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic data in the Synchro traffic analysis tool Synchro interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic data in the Paramics traffic analysis tool Paramics interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic data in the SimTraffic traffic analysis tool SimTraffic interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic management data in TMS/H interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish weather data elements as enumerated in APPENDIX D - Weather Data Elements from Clarus output format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish asset condition data using the asset condition data interface format.
The DUAP System shall publish alerts.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish traffic condition alerts using the traffic condition alert interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish weather condition alerts using the weather condition alert interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish asset condition alerts using the asset condition alert interface format.
The DUAP Output Services shall be able to publish alerts using the threshold exceeded alert interface format when thresholds have been exceeded.
The DUAP System shall log Output Services data transactions.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall present data published by Output Services.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall include a user interface for browsing traffic information.
The traffic information browser shall allow a user to query traffic-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The traffic information browser shall allow a user to view traffic-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The information browsers shall provide a means for users to select between Metric and English units of measurement for display.
The information browsers shall provide a map display which uses icons to identify the locations with associated data.
The system map display shall provide a means to select which data layers are displayed.
The system map display shall support each type of traffic item to be displayed in its own layer.
The system map display shall support pan and zoom capabilities to allow a user to select the area to be displayed.
The system map display shall support de-cluttering to reduce the number of icons displayed when large areas are displayed.
The information browsers shall provide tabular information identifying locations with associated data.
The tabular information display shall provide a means to select the data to be displayed.
The tabular information display shall provide a means to select the area to be displayed.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall include a user interface for browsing incident information.
The incident information browser shall allow a user to query incident-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The incident information browser shall allow a user to view incident-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall include a user interface for browsing traveler information.
The traveler information browser shall allow a user to query traveler-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The traveler information browser shall allow a user to view traveler-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall include a user interface for browsing asset condition information.

The asset condition information browser shall allow a user to query asset condition-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.

The asset condition information browser shall allow a user to view asset condition-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall include a user interface for browsing weather information.
The weather information browser shall allow a user to query weather-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The weather information browser shall allow a user to view weather-related information using a web browser capable of supporting HTML 4.01, JavaScript (ECMA-262 edition 3), and XML 1.0.
The DUAP System shall require users to log in for system access.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall require users to uniquely identify themselves.
The DUAP Presentation Services shall require users to confirm their identity.
The DUAP System shall log Presentation Services data transactions.
The DUAP System shall conform to IT standards established by the Michigan Department of Information Technology (MDIT).
The DUAP System shall implement data anonymization processes to ensure that individual vehicle and driver identities cannot be reconstructed from the collected probe data.
The DUAP System shall enforce strong password policies, including minimum length and complexity requirements, and implement session timeouts after 15 minutes of inactivity.
All data transmissions between external systems and the DUAP system shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher, and all sensitive data stored in Persistent Data Services shall be encrypted at rest.
The DUAP System shall store logs in a secure, tamper-evident format with restricted access, and retain security logs for a minimum of one year.
The DUAP System shall maintain a rolling cache of all incoming and derived data for a minimum of 7 days, supporting a peak ingestion rate of [X] records per second.
The DUAP System shall log all data transactions to a persistent store with a retention period of [Y] days and a rotation policy to prevent disk space exhaustion.
The DUAP System shall implement automated retry logic with exponential backoff for all external data interfaces and provide health status monitoring for each input service.

The DUAP System shall validate incoming data against defined schemas and quality flags; data failing validation shall be quarantined and logged, and the system shall continue processing valid records.
The DUAP System shall support a storage throughput of [X] MB/s and a total persistent storage capacity of [Y] TB to accommodate one week of data retention for [Z] concurrent data sources.
The DUAP System shall process and make available incoming data within [X] milliseconds of receipt, and presentation services shall refresh displays within [Y] seconds of data availability.
The DUAP System shall support [X] concurrent users accessing the presentation services and [Y] concurrent external system connections for data output without exceeding a [Z] second response time.
